agreement-page.title: Data Processing Terms
agreement-page.subtitle: Official agreement on the collection, storage and protection of personal information of users of the game project 'Chronicles of the End'

nickname.text: Used to identify the user on the website, as well as to synchronize the account with the Minecraft game server.

password.text: The password is stored exclusively in encrypted form (hash). Even in the event of an unforeseen database leak, no one will be able to find out your original password.

email.text: Used for bot protection, password reset and confirmation of critical actions. We undertake not to send marketing emails, advertising or spam.

roleplay.text: Information about belonging to game cities and states, participation in elections, voting, as well as game statistics (registration date, activity, session IP address).

economy.text: Data on game bank accounts, in-game currency balances, history of financial transfers, bank cards and ownership of company shares on the stock exchange.

oauth.text: When using Google account login, only the email address is extracted and saved from your Google profile.

location.text: All users' personal data is stored on secure servers located in the Federal Republic of Germany.

deletion.text: You have the right to delete your account from the site at any time. This will entail 'soft deletion' of data and irretrievable loss of game progress on the site.

softDelete.text: A special mark of data in the database that makes it impossible to use them further. Final irretrievable deletion occurs automatically after 1 month.
